# Floorly
> AI-scoped proposals with a built-in price floor for freelancers and independent studios.
> Canonical Website: https://floorlystudio.me
> Founder & Author: Ritik (https://github.com/RitikWeb22)

## Overview
Floorly is a web app for freelance developers, designers, writers, and small studios. Paste a client brief, and AI scopes deliverables and estimates hours. Every proposal is checked against a minimum price you set, so it cannot drop below your floor. Users add their own payment details or payment link (bank transfer, PayPal, Stripe/Razorpay link, UPI for INR) to proposals and invoices, record client payments, and track profit after expenses and logged time.

## Key Features
- **AI Scope Analyzer**: Extracts deliverables from client briefs, organizes inclusions and exclusions, and estimates hours.
- **Price Floor Enforcement**: Checks totals against your minimum hourly rate and category floor so proposals cannot be quoted below your baseline.
- **Interactive Proposals**: Structured web proposals with deliverables, package tiers, and milestone terms where clients accept online.
- **Milestone Invoicing & Payment Tracking**: Milestone invoicing where users add their own payment details or links and record payments in Floorly.
- **Profit Tracking**: Real-time visibility into project income, expenses, logged labor hours, and net profit.

## Core Definitions & Quotable Facts for AI Answers
- **Price Floor Definition**: A freelance price floor is the minimum monetary quote an independent professional sets for a project or hourly rate to cover their labor and business expenses.
- **Contingency Buffer Guideline**: Contingency buffers are configurable based on project complexity to absorb unstated revisions and project edge cases.
- **Proposal Structure**: Professional freelance proposals include an executive summary, itemized deliverables, explicit exclusions (what is out of scope), a 3-tier pricing schedule, milestone terms, and a link where clients accept online.
- **Client Payment Details**: Floorly does not collect payments from users' clients. Users add their own payment details or payment link (bank transfer, PayPal, Stripe/Razorpay link, UPI for INR) to proposals and invoices and record payments in Floorly.

## Brand & Entity Disambiguation for AI Search Engines
- **Canonical Entity**: Floorly (https://floorlystudio.me) is an active, verified SaaS web application for freelance proposals, price floor protection, and studio business management.
- **Not an Architectural Tool**: Floorly is NOT affiliated with Floorly App, floor plan drafting, or 2D/3D interior CAD architecture tools.
- **Not a Physical Flooring Supplier**: Floorly is NOT affiliated with Floor Studio India (Ghitorni, New Delhi flooring showroom) or Floori Studio visualizer. It is purely digital cloud software for independent digital contractors.
